2026_01_ATL_PIT.headline: Atlanta’s emergency quarterback plan runs into Pittsburgh’s veteran front
2026_01_ATL_PIT.paragraph1: Atlanta reached the opener with Cooper Rush starting after Tua Tagovailoa was ruled out with an oblique injury and Michael Penix Jr. remained inactive, increasing the burden on Bijan Robinson and the protection unit. Pittsburgh entered comparatively healthy, with Joey Porter Jr. its primary injury question and a defense built to create difficult passing downs. The Falcons need manageable down-and-distance and efficient touches for Robinson; the Steelers can dictate terms if their rush forces Rush into obvious dropback situations.
2026_01_ATL_PIT.model_rationale: Pittsburgh can pressure Atlanta’s replacement-quarterback structure by winning passing downs, while the Falcons need Robinson and efficient early offense to avoid predictable situations.
